description: Five hand-labelled project briefs for Session 10 retrieval evaluation. A chunk is relevant when its parent budget_id appears in relevant_budget_ids.

queries.query: Mobile banking application with OAuth2 authentication, PSD2 open banking compliance, strong customer authentication and a transaction ledger.
Headless e-commerce storefront with a product catalog, shopping cart checkout and personalized product recommendations.
Telemedicine platform for patient appointment scheduling and video consultations with HL7/FHIR integration and clinical records.
Industrial IoT platform ingesting sensor telemetry for predictive maintenance and real-time equipment monitoring in a factory.
Real-time payments gateway with fraud detection, transaction reconciliation and a double-entry ledger.
